name: The Wraith in the Woods
source:
Take on the role of a guy who goes on a camping trip with his friends – only for things to go sideways when something starts lurking in the woods.

[From [url=https://justinxcrafter.itch.io/wraithinthewoods]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
扮演一个和朋友一起去野营旅行的人——只是当树林里开始潜伏着什么东西时，事情就发生了变化。

[来自[url=https://justinxcrafter.itch.io/wraithinthewoods]Itch.io[/url]]
